usageNotes: Returns the sub-resource directory index for a specific SDN zone scoped to a PDM node — useful for discovering what child endpoints are available under a given zone. No query parameters are accepted; supply the node name and zone ID as path parameters. Accessible to all authenticated users, including API token-based access.

examples.summary: Fetch the directory index for SDN zone 'vlan10' on node 'pdm-node1'

tips: The response type is null in the schema, meaning this is a directory-listing endpoint — use it to navigate available sub-resources rather than retrieve zone configuration details.
To get actual zone configuration data (type, MTU, peers, etc.), query the PDM SDN zones list endpoint at the cluster level instead of the per-node path.
Zone IDs in Proxmox SDN follow the naming constraint of alphanumeric characters with hyphens; ensure the zone value matches exactly as defined in the SDN configuration.
